item_totals.name: item_totals
item_totals.value: "order_items"."quantity" > 0 AND "order_items"."unit_price_minor" >= 0 AND "order_items"."subtotal_minor" = "order_items"."quantity" * "order_items"."unit_price_minor" AND "order_items"."discount_minor" BETWEEN 0 AND "order_items"."subtotal_minor" AND "order_items"."total_minor" = "order_items"."subtotal_minor" - "order_items"."discount_minor"

order_amounts.name: order_amounts
order_amounts.value: "orders"."currency" = 'KZT' AND "orders"."subtotal_minor" >= 0 AND "orders"."discount_minor" BETWEEN 0 AND "orders"."subtotal_minor" AND "orders"."total_minor" = "orders"."subtotal_minor" - "orders"."discount_minor" AND "orders"."processing_fee_minor" BETWEEN 0 AND "orders"."total_minor"
